column1: # Hand adjustments to the 1836 works seed, added to infrastructure_seed_baseline.tsv
# by Merge-InfrastructurePlan.ps1 to give infrastructure_seed_plan.tsv. The baseline is
# vanilla rail and port replacement only, rewritten by Get-StartingInfrastructure.ps1 on
# every regeneration; these balance changes are kept here so a regeneration can't lose them.
# Columns: state, owner, Road Works level change, Harbour Works level change (may be negative).
# 1.15 balance pass 2 (2026-11-06): +47 Road Works levels in states the opening left short,
# mostly through the housing seed's own usage; docs/reports/balance_6_Nov_2026_1.15/BALANCE_LOG.md.
# Rostov (RUS) is not adjusted: the baseline gives it 1 Harbour Works for its vanilla port,
# which the plan before 2026-11-09 had missed.
